levels.title: Patrol route
levels.mission: The guards patrol the vault in a fixed order. Click the rooms in the order they will be visited.

levels.title: Decode the blueprint
levels.mission: Rebuild the vault from its preorder and inorder patrol lists.

levels.title: Measure the shafts
levels.mission: Answer the height of the tree, then the length of its longest path.

levels.title: Trace the escape route
levels.mission: Name the lowest common room of 20 and 80, then the length of the path between them.

levels.title: Mirror the floor plan
levels.mission: Swap the children of each branching room until the plan is mirrored, or use Auto.
